Package index

Recontextualization methods

Baseline methods that take a source-context signature and reconstruct it in a target context.

projectCor()
Reconstruct Gene Signatures Using Projection Scores
network_sig()
Finds a simulated network signature
recontextualize()
Recontextualize signatures with a selected baseline method

Network utilities

Building and propagating across gene co-expression networks.

wgcna.adj()
Construct WGCNA Adjacency Matrix
random_walk()
Perform a random walk with restart (personalized page rank) on an igraph given a seed matrix, and return stationary probabilties. Stripped down and corrected version of dnet: https://rdrr.io/cran/dnet/src/R/dRWR.r

Benchmarking & evaluation

Evaluating a recontextualized signature against source/true signatures.

sig_eval_table()
Evaluate Signature Prediction
paired_eval_table()
Pair a Recontextualization Evaluation Table With a No-Change Baseline
sig_filter_fn()
Filter Significant Genes by Perturbation
recon_eval_df()
Evaluate recontextualized signatures
jaccard()
Calculate Jaccard Similarity Between Two Sets
jaccard_matrix()
Create a Jaccard Similarity Matrix for Multiple Sets
v.jaccard()
Calculate Jaccard Similarity for Multiple Pairs of Sets
v.fgsea()
Vectorized fgsea wrapper for multiple gene set comparisons
fgsea_wrapper()
fgsea wrapper for gene symbol vectors
fishers_meta_p()
Combine P-values Using Fisher's Method
count_displaced_genes()
Count number of displaced seeds Note: This not commutative. Num_displaced is the number of genes that are from the original seed that are not in the recon.
bin_presence()
Check Presence in Bins for Numbers 1-100

Find all pairwise distances between nodes in an igraph
annotate_prob_vec()
Returns a dataframe object with the stationary probability value and column indicating whether gene was a seed
binarize_matrices()
Binarize Multiple Matrices Based on Cutoffs
col_normalize()
Normalize Columns of a Matrix
common_mad_genes()
Find Common Genes with Highest Median Absolute Deviation (MAD) Across ExpressionSets
common_signature_filter()
Filter Signatures for Common Nodes Across Graphs
consensus_net()
Create a Consensus Network from Multiple Networks
correlated_sigs()
Recontextualize seed signatures with correlation based neighbors
diag_zero()
Set Diagonal of a Matrix to Zero
extract_sig_mat()
Extracts a signature from a (gene x seed) matrix of stationary probability values. This is the recontextualized signature. If doing ks.test, you don't need to find the top_n. Just find ks.test(original, recontextualized ranking) before and after.
ggempty()
An empty ggplot
ggeplot()
Enrichment plot implemented in ggplot

pvector
A push/pop capable vector
rank.var.eset()
Rank Genes in an ExpressionSet/SummarizedExperiment by Variability
seed_matrix()
Create (gene x seed) prior matrix based on seed signatures.
seurat_common_var_genes()
Find Common Variable Genes Across Seurat Objects
sft.check()
Check and Return Soft-Thresholding Power from WGCNA
